item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi sbyin bsregs bskal pa'i me dpung
item.coloph: de ltar dbang dang drag po'i sbyin bsregs (sreg) gzhung*/ phyi rabs dod du bdag gis thugs bcud phyung/ g.yung drung gsal la gnyer gtad dam pa bzung / skabs shig bon la 'phra nyag cung shar tshe/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug byang nub mtshams/ gcung po'i byin rlabs dpal ri'i gnas tshab la/ gter sbos ma 'ong ('ongs) rnyed pa'i smon lam thob/ gter srung rnams kyi (kyis) ma g.yel bya ra gzob(gzobs//) phyis su bdag 'dra gshen sprul she skya nyi ris/ phug leb 'o ma stag rtse nas zab mo gter gyi sgrom bu rnyed te (de) lo mang gsang rgya gdam (bsdams/)slar hor sras rin po che sogs/ dam ldan du mas bskul ngor/ shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
